reviews.x: I work night shift and sleep days.  This is the best sleeping mask I have ever found.  No lights get under them or through them.  They are so comfortable, too.  They have greatly improved my rest and sleep.  My cats have a tendency to move the curtains around to look outside thus allowing light and sunshine to come in.  With this mask I never even notice it any more.

reviews.t: Best sleep mask out of dozens tried, here's why:
reviews.x: I've tried a lot of sleep masks from super cheap like this one to the more expensive ones like manta sleep mask.  This is the best as it meets 3 big problems with most: 1. Light blocking is awesome.  The nose, the sides, the top. It's amazing how many sleep masks don't get this right.  2. The adjustable fastener is velcro, not a buckle in the back. 3. This mask doesn't hit your eyes when sleeping.  Pressure on your eyes causes them to be red in the morning.  I'll be getting a few extra of these.

I'd consider myself as a sleep mask "expert" having worn them for nearly 14 years.  This is in my top 2 favorites.  Good sleep masks are SO HARD to find..trust me, I've gone through A LOT!  This mask is soft, comfortable and conforms nicely to my face & blocks out the light perfectly.  The only criticism I have is the velcro in back.  Usually the velcro is uncomfortable when paired with a really firm pillow IF you sleep on your back (creates a hard lump back there).  However, this hasn't been a

reviews.t: It actually leaves black paint on your face!
reviews.x: I liked it the first couple nights, because then apparently I slept on my back only. But then for one reason or another I started sleeping on my side, and I started waking up with blackish-grayish cast around my eyes. At first I couldn't understand where it came from, but one morning the grey imprint was so thick, that there was no more doubt. It is a shame, since the design is great - there is extra fabric not to let light peek in from under the nose, from the sides of eyes. They need to do som
The product is very comfortable and it would have been a 5 star item, but after a few night the dye on the inside of the sleep mask left a black stain on my sheets.

reviews.t: Purchase one for each member of your family that likes to sleep in the dark!
reviews.x: I received this on time and decided to try it out for a few days before leaving a review. You know how it is when you are trying something new when you are asleep, you need to get used to it as it is a change. It did not take long to get used to at all!!! Very comfortable and keeps things nice and dark. There is a little extra materials around the inside of the nose area to help keep things dark as this is usually where light likes to seep through. There is a memory foam lining around the outsid

I have tried many sleep masks over the years and couldn't find one that kept the light completely out. This sleep mask is so don't and snug without being too tight....the best part is no light at all creeps in!!

reviews.t: Great fit and superior build quality.
reviews.x: I've used several sleep masks in the past. They all worked well enough for a short time, but quickly fell apart quickly with the elastic stretching and fabric becoming unglued. This model is built significantly better with a thicker elastic and much better fit and design around the nose section. The nose section is a separate lofty, contoured piece that fills in the space without putting pressure on the nose. The eye cups are raised up from the eye sockets. reviews.t: Just what I was hoping for
reviews.x: So, so soft.  I don't like the color grey, but I was willing to buy and try.  They work well. They block out all light, although, at first some came around the nose area until I straightened out the nose fabric.  I'll use them on a flight this summer and they will keep me from seeing so many distractions that normally keep me awake; I get distracted easily, and I just can't sleep on airlines.  I would recommend them to anyone and would buy again.
Love being able to open or close my eyes with the mask on. Light weight and comfortable

reviews.t: Blocks out light around nose area unlike many others I've tried
reviews.x: Exactly what I was looking for blocks out all light around nose area would have given 5 stars if it was priced below $12
Cant tell the difference between my eyes being open or closed when I wear this with a lot of light exposure. These are awesome and comfortable!
Foam eye mask plain and simple no cooling at all

This mask does a great job of blocking light. But waking up with a stained face that required harsh scrubbing isnt worth it (especially with sensitive skin). I hand washed it twice to attempt to fix the problem. Seems fine if I sleep on my back. Being a side sleeper seems to put to much pressure on the mask and leaves me looking like someone punched me. If I flip and flop I wake up looking like a raccoon. Maybe cover the dyed material and this could be fixed?

This sleep mask is just what it says in the description. It's comfortable, blacks out all lights, the grove in the eye and nose area is awesome, I can use it with my eyelash extensions! Thank goodness I bought three!

When I received the mask I let it air out for 24 hours as the instructions said, then I wore it a few nights, it was very comfortable and really blacked out all light, but it still smelled a little chemically. After wearing it for a few nights I looked in my 10X magnifying mirror to put some makeup on and thought I was growing black hair on my face, yikes!!!! It was the mask that stained my face around the area that it covered.  I was able to wash some off my face but some stayed, even after dee

Pros: I love this mask, it's super comfortable and blocks the light well.  Cons: It leaves black specks where it touches your skin and it takes some scrubbing to get them off.  If not for that it would be 5 stars, hands down.

I absolutely love this mask. I work nights so this was a life saver. The one flaw I’ve noticed was when it was left on my white sheets. It stained my sheets black. I’m not sure if hand washing it will fix the problem, but be cautious!
I love it’s completely dark and so comfy ! Bought em for stocking stuffer but try them first and fell in love

reviews.t: This is the one to get! Blocks out light, Plenty of room for long eyelashes, Velcro adjustable strap
reviews.x: Been a fan of Bucky Eye Shades which I bought several years ago... but reviews of Bucky say the quality has gone downhill. I still have one left that still functional but it won't last too much longer.  Since then, there have been "Advancements" in the eye shades industry, emphasizing design to block out light, "3D" cushioning around the eyes so shade is not too tight on them, and variations on strap design (velcro vs thin flat buckle.)  I ordered 6 different brands - each one with a problem, at

This is comfortable and blocks light completely. It is everything it claims. There’s no pressure on your eyes, if you open your them, your eyelashes don’t touch the mask. I would have been extremely pleased if it weren’t so hot. The mask is very large and cover much more than your eyes and the memory foam collects heat and keeps it close. I will use this if it’s all I have but the heat gives me a headache. I much prefer the manta sleep mask is better but much more expensive.

I first was worried about having one but I love it. It works great for when you need to sleep and the sun doesn't agree with your timing. Also comes with ear plugs so when I got a headache I just put those in and the mask on and zone out to relax.

Not for side sleepers. The memory foam is too thick to comfortably sleep on your side as it pushes the mask and causes light to get it. I also had trouble with the straps irritating my ears. I will be returning.

Really comfortable, can't see any light from it. Makes sleeping so much easier, I like how there's space for my eyes as previous eye masks felt a little uncomfortable when I would accidentally open them.
It works pretty well, but when I wake up in the morning I see it had left a black stain on my forehead. Back to square one

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the mask for blocking out light completely, including around the nose and sides.
Many reviewers describe the mask as soft and comfortable to wear.
Several reviewers report that the mask's dye or paint stains their face or sheets, especially when sleeping on their side.
Some reviewers note the mask is well built and fits snugly without being too tight.
A few reviewers mention the price or value, with one wanting it cheaper and another noting it lacks cooling.
